simple.meaning: שָׁרַת (shârath) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 98 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 39:4. Its contexts include family line, altar, priesthood, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁרַת (H8334).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁרַת (shârath) / H8334 is traced through Genesis 39:4, Genesis 40:4, Exodus 24:13, Exodus 28:35 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to
definitions.full: H8334. sharath [ שָׁרַת ] 97 verb Pi`el minister, serve (compare Late Hebrew שֵׁרוּת (temple-) ministry , Phoenician משרת ministry , and perhaps verb שרת minister ); — Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular שֵׁרֵת Num 8:26 ; Deut 18:7 ; 3 masculine plural שֵׁרְתוּ Num 3:6 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיְשָׁ֫רֶת Gen 39:4 , 3 masculine plural יְשָֽׁרְתוּ Num 3:31 +, etc.; Infinitive construct לְשָׁרֵת Exod 28:35 +, שָׁם לְשָׁ֫רֶת Deut 17:12 , etc.; Participle מְשָׁרֵת Num 11:28 + ( 2Sam 13:9 see מַשְׂרֵת , p. 602:a), feminine מְשָׁרַת 1Kin 1:15 , etc.; — serve: 1 of ministerial service (opposed tomenial, עבד ): a. higher domestic service: Joseph Gen 39:4 ; 40:4 (JE), Elisha's chief servant 2Kin 4:43 ; 6:15 , royal domestics 2Sam 13:17-18 , 1Kin 10:5 ; 2Chr 9:4 ; Est 2:2 ; 6:3 , Abishag 1Kin 1:4 , 15 . b. of royal officers (late) 1Chr 27:1 ; 28:1 ; 2Chr 17:19 ; 22:8 ; Est 1:10 ; Prov 29:12 . c.
